concurrency_verification.raw_metric_explanation: vLLM serve.py calculate_metrics counts inclusive one-second buckets; adjacent serial requests share a bucket. This bucket metric is not simultaneous request concurrency. Client last-token times do not overlap subsequent starts; server and client limits both1.

full_phase_host_wall_rooflines.attribution: Disjoint intervals between consecutive adapter-observed async completions, attributed to the ending completion phase; first interval starts at first client request. Plugin host sampling/output/scheduling, communication and idle gaps after adapter return fall inside following intervals; final client tail assigned to last phase. Operator decision4 approved attribution. No extra synchronization or live device profiler. Host wall time, not device time.

device_time_missing_reason: Live vLLM profiling prohibited; full-phase host-wall accounting is not device time or device roofline.
